---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new capability for Focentra
title: "[FEATURE]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? A clear description of what the obstacle or need is.
*(Example: "I want to track study sessions by specific project tags and see tag-based breakdowns.")*

## ✨ Proposed Solution / Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision it working.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🚀 Expected Benefit & Value
Why should this feature be built? How does it improve the offline focus experience for users?

## 🎨 UI/UX Mockup or Sketches (Optional)
If applicable, attach rough mockups, diagrams, or visual examples.

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context or references here.
